exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.2.1–1.2.6 — information and support
exact_section.evidence_summary: Lists menstrual-cycle changes, vasomotor, genitourinary, mood, musculoskeletal, and sexual symptoms and their variable severity and duration.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_version: NICE NG23; last updated and reviewed 2026-04-15

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.3.1–1.3.6 — identifying perimenopause and menopause
exact_section.evidence_summary: Defines symptom-and-cycle-based identification in people aged 45 or over and limits laboratory and imaging tests, including FSH in specified contexts.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.4.1–1.4.3 — discussing management options
exact_section.evidence_summary: Requires benefit-risk discussion tailored to age, circumstances, risk factors, preferences, and repeated review when HRT is chosen.

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.5.5–1.5.13 — genitourinary symptoms
exact_section.evidence_summary: Covers clinician-discussed moisturiser, lubricant, and vaginal-treatment options and ongoing review for genitourinary symptoms.

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.9.1–1.9.3 — reviewing treatment
exact_section.evidence_summary: Defines documented review at three months, annually thereafter, or earlier for ineffectiveness, adverse effects, or clinical need.
